messages:
Nina: quick thread - noticed drift noise in golden-delta for q4 runs. proposing we add a lightweight drift-normalizer step before making pass/fail decisions.
Owen: what does normalizer do? smoothing across recent baselines?
Nina: yes. it takes last N golden deltas (default N=5), computes MAD and replaces single-run delta with robust aggregate to avoid flapping.
Priya: sounds helpful. how do we avoid masking real regressions?
Nina: normalizer emits both raw and smoothed values. policy DSL can choose to enforce raw_threshold or smoothed_threshold. default: require smoothed > threshold AND raw > threshold*0.9 to alert.
Marcus: ops ask: will this delay verdicts? we want quickpass to remain fast.
Nina: no - normalizer used only for final bench decision. fastpass still uses lint+tokenizer checks. normalizer runs as post-process on fullbench artifacts which are async.
sam-bot: NOTE: benchmark retention = 90d. archived artifacts available at s3://bench-archive/.
Owen: can you add a config sketch?
Nina: sure:
```
normalizer:
  window: 5
  method: mad
  multiplier: 2.5
policy:
  final_check:
    use: smoothed
    threshold: 0.05
    require_raw_agreement: true
```
Priya: +1. I'll add tests to fuzz harness to ensure noisy single-run spikes don't trigger quarantine.
Marcus: I'll adjust alerting to include both raw and smoothed values so SRE can triage.
Nina: thanks. I'll draft a short RFC and propose merging into probe-delegation post-meeting.
